info.name: Airtm Enterprise API V1 Payments / Payouts API

items.docs:
This endpoint allows you to create a payout instruction. In the request
body, information about the payout such as the recipient's email,
description, amount, and any URLs needed for confirmation or failure
redirects should be provided. Upon successful creation, the API returns
a response containing the details of the newly created payout, including
a unique ID.

After making a call to this endpoint, no money is moved yet. To finish
moving the money to a user you must call the payouts/:id/commit

After calling this endpoint, Airtm will execute/process the previously
received payout instruction. The RESPONSE confirms the reception and
incorporation of the payout instruction for processing. Funds will be
deducted from your balance while the payout execution process is being
carried out.

Please note that a 200 response doesn't necessarily mean the money
moved, it simply means the system is now trying to send the amount. Wait
for callbacks on `failure_uri`, `confirmation_uri` OR call
`/oper

This endpoint is a combination of the Create Payout and the Commit
Payout endpoints. If you want to do a payout in just one API call
instead of a two-step process outlined in Create / Commit Payout, you
can now use this one-step endpoint.

The usage is exactly the same as the **Create payout** endpoint at POST
/payouts with the only difference being that the second step (commit

This endpoint populates whenever either a Success URI or Failure URI are
called; this information helps track the status and whatever is
happening with the committed Payout.

This endpoint allows users to cancel specific `PENDING` individual
payouts—those that have been created and committed but where the
recipient has not yet signed up on Airtm.com.

To manually cancel a pending payout, users must provide the transaction
`id`, which can be retrieved when creating the payout through either the
**Create & Commit** or **One-Step** payout flows. Pending payouts will
